description: Defines the Time class and TimeAsLocal class for handling date and time operations, conversions, and formatting within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. Includes constants, constructors, parsing, formatting, and comparison operators.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: Represents a point in time with various constructors, parsing, formatting, and comparison functionalities, supporting both Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: TimeAsLocal
classes.description: Wraps a Time object to handle local time representation and conversions, providing comparison and arithmetic operators.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses a string into a Time object, supporting multiple date formats.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the Time object into a string representation.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds milliseconds to the Time object.

methods.name: Sub
methods.description: Subtracts milliseconds from the Time object.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the Time object contains a valid date/time.
